name: needs-shift-cycle-visual
description: Visual check of shift cycle. Finding #27: this file's own next step (`build upgrade 1`) is genuinely rejected — Tier 2 living_quarters is not researched — so the living_quarters this scenario builds stays at Tier 1 for its whole run. processShiftCycle (GameLoop.ts) requires `living_quarters tier >= 2` and returns `{active: false}` otherwise, doing nothing at all: no employee ever accrues ticksWorked or enters a forced shift rest through this mechanism. Confirmed via a direct trace that ticksWorked stays 0 and restTicksRemaining stays null through the whole scenario. Assertions describe this real, verified behavior (ordinary idle/work need-drain, no shift cycle) rather than the originally-intended "employees work 6 ticks then auto-enter 8-tick sleep rest" claim.
